title: Who may align, split and change realities
question: Which roles may change a reality's status, transformation matrix or images, or split it? Are these Track3D-only operations? When a reality is realigned or split, what must happen to its pinpoints, notes, measurements and progress? How is automatic alignment from "correctly aligned" realities supposed to work, and is there a confirmation step?
context: The split-merge PRD describes multi-reality walkthroughs, manual matrices and automatic alignment (VIEW-REQ-021, VIEW-REQ-022). Splitting refreshes pinpoints, the snapshot and capture counts (VIEW-REQ-020).
